description: Seagull于1970年推出的旁轴相机。配备S-111-2, 1:3.5/75mm。快门速度leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec and selftimer.。使用roll film of type 120。

specs.取景器: optical viewfinder with superimposed coupled rangefinder
specs.快门: leaf shutter with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec and selftimer.
specs.英文简介: The Seagull 203 is a rangefinder camera for rollfilm.
